But the description says "As a memory optimizing technique an empty array passed in will be overridden with the empty public static references in this class." So we need to refer to a static field. Let's assume there is a public static final Character[] EMPTY_ARRAY defined elsewhere. We can refer to it as EMPTY_ARRAY. So code: return array == null || array.length == 0 ? EMPTY_ARRAY : array;
